_comment: Verified nonnative status, current assessment context, and taxon-specific exceptions. These rows support identification and honest audit counts, not recommendations to remove all nonnative plants.
source: UF/IFAS Extension and Assessment, and FISC 2026
scope: Florida status evidence. Nonnative plants may still have documented wildlife value. Invasive false means not labelled invasive by the cited assessment/list; read management notes for conditional or moderate-risk findings.
planning_method: Planting requirements are intentionally unset for these classification-only records. They are excluded from the native-addition recommendation engine.

species.status_scope: Florida nativity and current cited invasive assessment; a negative invasive flag does not establish zero risk.
species.wildlife_support_basis: No species-specific wildlife relationship verified in this catalog.
species.why: UF/IFAS identifies this nursery firebush variety as nonnative. It must not inherit the native Florida variety's classification.
species.suitability_notes: Classification reference only. This native-addition planner does not recommend nonnative plants; nonnative status alone is not a reason to remove a plant.
species.taxonomy_notes: The variety epithet matters. The names Dwarf and Compacta are nursery aliases reported by UF/IFAS; a generic firebush label cannot confirm the native variety.
species.management_notes: Not included as an invasive entry in the FISC 2026 list. This is not a guarantee against escape or hybridization.

species.why: Green Island ficus is nonnative but is explicitly excluded from the FISC Ficus microcarpa invasive listing. Confirm this form before applying the exception.
species.suitability_notes: Classification reference only. This native-addition planner does not recommend nonnative plants; nonnative status alone is not a reason to remove a plant.
species.taxonomy_notes: FISC names the excluded form as subsp. fuyuensis; UF/IFAS also uses var. fuyuensis and Green Island. The 2026 PDF prints macrocarpa/susp. in its exception footnote; the 2023 list and UF/IFAS identify the intended microcarpa form.
species.management_notes: FISC exclusion is taxon-specific, not a blanket clearance for other Ficus microcarpa plants. This planner does not advise removal solely because a plant is nonnative.

species.why: Recent Florida botanical review reclassified tropical sage as nonnative. UF/IFAS still describes pollinator value and distinguishes the reclassification from invasiveness.
species.suitability_notes: Classification reference only. This native-addition planner does not recommend nonnative plants; nonnative status alone is not a reason to remove a plant.
species.taxonomy_notes: Updated October 2026 status supersedes older native labels in this catalog. The linked UF/IFAS report cites the Atlas of Florida Plants.
species.management_notes: Nonnative does not mean invasive. UF/IFAS retains this species in a pollinator demonstration garden while removing the native label.
